'''Malmar''' was an [[NPC]] located in the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}}. They sold a {{Item|Mining Pumpkin}}.

== Mechanics ==
'''Malmar''' appeared in various locations near railroad tracks on the seventh day of each month.

{{/UI}}

== Trivia ==
* '''Malmar'''{{'}}s spawning was often bugged, appearing when they were not supposed to and vice versa.
*'''Malmar''' was replaced with '''Brynmor''' who now sells various {{Skill|Mining}} [[Consumables]].
*'''Malmar''' has been referenced in the now renamed {{Item|Powder Pie}} with the question what happened to him.
